column4: The State of Massachusetts committed voter fraud by deleting over one million ballot images during the 2020 Presidential Election.
column7: The claim was made on Sept 24, 2020, before the actual 2020 Presidential Election (Nov 3, 2020), so it cannot refer to that election's results. It likely conflates with Shiva Ayyadurai's allegations about the Massachusetts September 1, 2020 primary election, where he claimed ballot scanning systems deleted or altered digital ballot images. Massachusetts election officials and independent election security experts examined these claims and found that the ballot scanning systems functioned as designed - the images in question were part of an internal audit trail of the voting machines, not official ballots, and their presence or absence did not affect vote tabulation or indicate fraud. No credible evidence supported the claim that ballots were altered or that fraud occurred. Election security experts and state officials publicly refuted this claim at the time.
